vnd.risk.page.title: Contractor risk grade
vnd.risk.page.subtitle: A risk score computed from what the controls found, with the explanation of every factor; a high grade needs a second person to confirm it.
vnd.risk.section.register.title: Register of risk grades
vnd.risk.rule.text: Weights and cut points come from the rule VENDOR_RISK (not verified). The grade does not decide whether a contractor may bid: it decides how deep the checking goes.

vnd.risk.figure.source: Risk grade register of lane VND-2, contractor research V13

vnd.risk.figure.review.formula: Contractors with a confirmed grade not past its review day over contractors with a confirmed grade

vnd.risk.figure.high.formula: Contractors with a confirmed grade of HIGH or CRITICAL

vnd.risk.assess.title: Assess the risk grade
vnd.risk.assess.note: The system computes the grade from the data it holds and keeps it as a proposal; the grade is written on the contractor only when somebody confirms it.

vnd.risk.decide.dual.note: This grade needs a dual check: the person who decides must be another than the assessor.

vnd.risk.tier.CRITICAL.name: Critical

vnd.risk.state.REJECTED.name: Rejected
vnd.risk.factor.PROFILE_GAP.name: Profile gaps
vnd.risk.factor.PROFILE_GAP.formula: Weight times the share of profile fields missing; an unknown coverage counts the whole weight
vnd.risk.factor.RESTRICTION.name: Restrictions
vnd.risk.factor.RESTRICTION.formula: A restriction in force adds the whole weight; a past one adds a third
vnd.risk.factor.REPUTATION_EVENTS.name: Bid conduct events
vnd.risk.factor.REPUTATION_EVENTS.formul: A third of the weight for each posted event that still weighs, up to three
vnd.risk.factor.QUALIFICATION_LAPSE.name: Lapsed certificates
vnd.risk.factor.QUALIFICATION_LAPSE.form: A third of the weight for each lapsed certificate, up to three
vnd.risk.factor.PAYEE_ALERT.name: Payee account alerts
vnd.risk.factor.PAYEE_ALERT.formula: A third of the weight for each alert (shared account, stalled change), up to three
vnd.risk.factor.POOR_PERFORMANCE.name: Consecutive poor ratings
vnd.risk.factor.POOR_PERFORMANCE.formula: Weight times the consecutive poor ratings over three, up to three
vnd.risk.factor.FINANCE_BELOW.name: Finance below the line
vnd.risk.factor.FINANCE_BELOW.formula: Below the line adds the whole weight; insufficient data adds half; unknown adds nothing
vnd.risk.factor.LOAD_OVER.name: Load over capacity
vnd.risk.factor.LOAD_OVER.formula: A load over the revenue multiple or too many late contracts adds the whole weight
vnd.risk.factor.OPEN_FINDINGS.name: Strong independence findings undecided
vnd.risk.factor.OPEN_FINDINGS.formula: A third of the weight for each strong finding with no decision, up to three
vnd.risk.factor.SUBCONTRACT_BREACH.name: Subcontract limit breaches
vnd.risk.factor.SUBCONTRACT_BREACH.formu: A third of the weight for each breach, up to three
vnd.risk.factor.SECURITY_FORFEIT.name: Forfeited bid securities
vnd.risk.factor.SECURITY_FORFEIT.formula: A third of the weight for each forfeiture, up to three
vnd.performance.page.title: Contract performance and its publication
vnd.performance.page.subtitle: The adopted ratings of contractors, the six-month publication limit, the answers of contractors and the streak of poor ratings.
vnd.performance.section.worklist.title: Publication of the ratings
vnd.performance.rule.text: The publication limit, the review of answers and the levels of the streak come from the rule VENDOR_PERFORMANCE (not verified); contractors answer within the limit of the rule EGP_POSTING_DEADLINES code CONTRACTOR_RESPONSE.
